text: Historic387 saved msgKey values and excluded multifolder views because keys were not globally unique. Current saved state records full message URIs and finds them with findIndexForMsgURI; the earlier multifolder exclusion is gone. Synthetic views keep a dedicated key because they own their about3pane. Keep current URI identities and do not reintroduce local keys from old tests.
title: Store message selection with an identity that survives multifolder views
